mode: AB-R exact-full-name homonym adversarial candidate discovery
source: Original 5,600 Interior elected Congress entries for elections 1977-2023, SHA cafc4e0f3fc53f01d1370dd47ac841c6cad43a5394e8a8d1afe2495897fbdad4
question: Can an exact full-name match recurring across widely separated elections be independently shown to represent different people rather than the same politician, using date of birth and original official person profiles?
H1: Among labels recurring at least 35 calendar years, at least one apparent name-only longitudinal link can be contradicted by independent official biographies/person profiles proving distinct identities.
H0: All selected labels may plausibly refer to same individuals or source lacks enough independent evidence to adjudicate a negative.

design.selection: Normalize NFKD accents, punctuation and case; include each label present in ≥2 election dates and max(year)-min(year) ≥35; order by temporal span descending then normalized label ascending; investigate no more than first 5 distinct labels to prevent selection chasing.
design.confirm_positive: Official source profile for each historical person that explicitly validates term chronology and birth data with unmistakable same-person source reference or biography.
design.confirm_negative: Direct independent official institution profile birth dates or source records that demonstrate two distinct persons sharing exact normalized full name, with no reliance solely on shift of party/province; impossible age chronology may count only if date of birth grounded.
design.uncertain: Any insufficiency or mere distant years is unresolved; no guaranteed negative claim.
design.public_reporting: No raw full-name panel in GitHub until official disambiguation; store candidate span and IDs where public official profile supports, no private signatures.

source_exposure: Earlier C08 aggregate counts known (1,306 recurrent names), but no long-span selected names examined in this turn before prereg
limits: A negative example does not estimate false link population rate.
